# Password Generator 1.5.1

This patch release introduces the finalized Password Generator application icon.

## Changed
- Adopted the final app icon across Android launcher resources.
- Added `artwork/app-icon.webp` as the canonical icon source for future releases.
- Added `store-assets/app-icon-512.png` for store publication.
- Updated launcher resources for all supported Android densities.

The password generation logic and privacy model are unchanged.
